remarks: Coming Soon. A grand single-story home in guard-gated Victoria Estates, North Oxnard. 2,721 sq ft, 5 bedrooms, 4 baths, arranged for flexible multi-generational living. A wall of French doors opens the great room to the backyard. The beautiful custom kitchen with an upgraded stove flows into a second living room with a fireplace. One bedroom is a full private suite with its own outside entrance and bath. Two bedrooms sit at the front, with the primary suite and another bedroom privately tucked at the end. Primary bath with dual vanities, soaking tub, separate shower, and walk-in closet. Four-car driveway plus a big two-car garage. Seven minutes to the freeway and The Collection, and minutes
